label: Cold stone, composition omissions and first-being act priority facts
paraphrase: Closed controls over Bool beings (true a ground, false a stone) and Bool respects (true esse, false heat). (1) Cold stone: act priority at first beings, non-overlap, every first being in act in some respect, act and potency make composite, every composite has a distinct cause of its being, causing another's perfection is efficient causing, efficient causes are prior, the ground is a first being and the stone is in potency to heat, while act's simple priority over every potency fails: the stone has a simply prior ground but nothing is in act in heat. (2) Dropping any one of the five composition-route premises (first being in act, act and potency make composite, composite has a cause, causing another's perfection is efficient causing, efficient causes are prior) leaves the other four and non-overlap while a first stone is in potency to heat with nothing in act in heat, so first-being act priority fails. (3) For every carrier: the strong reading implies the first-being version; the first-being version with non-overlap gives that a first being is in potency in no respect; that conclusion gives the first-being version back; the strong reading, non-overlap and a bridge from simple priority between distinct beings to a relation G give every being in potency a distinct G-predecessor in act in that respect; and non-overlap is needed for the second fact. Statements about these interpretations and implications only.
